steps.content:
`median()` had three bugs. `sort()` with no comparator sorts as strings, so 100 came before 9. It also sorted the caller's array in place, which broke `summarize`'s input. For even-length input it returned the upper-middle value instead of the mean of the two middle values.

The fix is in `src/stats.js`: sort a copy with `(a, b) => a - b`, and average the middle pair when the length is even. `npm test` now passes 5 of 5.

The explore agent found only two callers, `summarize` in `src/report.js` and the tests. Both want what the fix does, since `summarize` needs its input left alone.

I committed the change, but `git push` failed because the repo has no remote or upstream configured.
